AP1000 RGB Light — APKINA

A 24W RGB light with 24 effects, app control and a built-in 5200mAh battery.

SPECIFICATIONS
Power: 24W
Built-in battery: 5200mAh, 7.4V
Colour temperature: 2500–9900K, adjustable
Colour adjustment: 0–360° full colour gamut
Lighting effects: 24
Luminous flux: 1800 lm
Beam angle: 45°
LED beads: 144
App control: Supported
QC/PD fast charging: Supported
Weight: 980g
Shell material: Aluminium alloy shell + ABS plug/baffle + PC cover
Dimensions: 605 × 100 × 41mm
